scope: Local development runtime only; no production release
observed: After repeated dist rebuilds while Wrangler dev remained running, root, index.html and hotel-checkout returned the static 404 document.
diagnosis: Consistent with stale/incomplete local asset-manifest state during rebuild; no source checkout-routing defect established.
recovery: Stopped only the agent-owned Wrangler session and restarted the same config/port without changing credentials or financial flags.
recommendation: Finish the build before starting the local QA Worker; restart that Worker if asset routing is stale. No extra Google/provider call is needed.
